data.title: About Karanjeet
bio: Karanjeet grew up in Spotswood and Old Bridge NJ.  Currently, he goes to Rutgers University- School of Arts and Sciences and is working on transferring to Rutgers Business School.  When he’s not working as a Real Estate Agent, Karanjeet enjoys biking, nature, and the environment.

Karanjeet is excited to join Green Light Realty, a local agency dedicated to the future of our clients and communities.  He is ready to help individuals and families find or sell their home.  Before he chose to dive into the real estate sector, he grew his sales expertise through cars.
He has learned the best ways to help his clients through his car selling experience and plans to bring the same energy into his home selling goals.  Call him today at 732-599-5788!
